title: Azure DevOps Organization Groups & Baseline Entitlements Schema
description: Validates organization-scoped security groups and role assignments.

name.description: Display name of the organization-level security group.

description.description: Purpose and governance responsibility of this group.

role_tier.description: Governance tier mapping to organization permissions.

entra_group_origin_id.description: Optional Entra ID (Azure AD) Group Object ID to back this AzDO group.

members.description: Direct user principal names (prefer Entra ID group backing where possible).
